tools.title: Place-Value Blocks
tools.description: Build numbers to 9,999 with thousands cubes, hundreds flats, tens rods and ones. See standard, expanded and word form, and regroup 10 of one place into 1 of the next.

tools.title: Arrays and Area Models
tools.description: Build a multiplication array, split it into tens and ones, and see the partial products add up to the whole product.

tools.title: Division: Groups and Arrays
tools.description: Share counters into equal groups or arrange them in rows. See the quotient, the remainder and the multiplication check.

tools.title: Equivalent Fraction Models
tools.description: Shade a fraction bar, then cut every part into smaller equal parts. The amount stays the same while the numerator and denominator are multiplied by the same number.

tools.title: Fraction Number Line
tools.description: Jump along a number line by equal fractions. See a fraction as a multiple of a unit fraction, as a mixed number, and as a product.
topics: Multiplying a fraction by a whole number

tools.title: Decimal Grids
tools.description: Shade tenths and hundredths on a 10 by 10 grid. Read the amount as a fraction, as tenths plus hundredths, as a decimal and in words, and compare two decimals.

tools.title: Angle Explorer
tools.description: Turn a ray around a point and read the angle on a protractor. See the angle type, the fraction of a full turn, and how two angles add.

tools.title: Area and Perimeter Explorer
tools.description: Stretch a rectangle on a grid and watch its area and perimeter change. Find rectangles with the same area and different perimeters, or the same perimeter and different areas.

tools.title: Symmetry and Shapes
tools.description: Choose a shape and turn a fold line through its center. The tool flips one side over the line so you can see whether the two parts match, and lists the shape's sides and angles.
